summary: Spec item 5.16 (LaTeX rendering: block + inline + mid-line $$...$$ collision fix) verified with strong combined evidence. Build confirmed deployed. Bundle regex precedence verified to put $$...$$ alternative BEFORE single-$ alternative. Live DOM verification on BA's reference dev-verify-131502 session shows 4 .katex elements (2 inline, 2 display) on BOTH desktop 1280x720 and mobile 390x844 viewports with correct annotations (a^2+b^2=c^2 inline x2, E=mc^2 display x2), KaTeX stylesheet loaded, and ZERO raw `$$E`, `$a^2`, or `$ E` leakage in body text. The mid-line case (AC1/AC_C) is verified by bundle regex source extraction + live in-browser regex test on all 5 test inputs producing correct match groups. Direct UI-message verification of mid-line $$ was attempted but blocked because the dev-verify-131502 session is INACTIVE (last seen 15 hours ago) — sending is queued/not visible. Evidence chain (source + bundle + live regex test + dual-viewport DOM rendering of equivalent canonical content) is conclusive that the fix works. Warning: AC_C (mid-line) lacks a directly-rendered live DOM bubble for the EXACT mid-line input; the fix is verified through equivalent regex behavior on the deployed bundle.
user_verbatim_complaint: block latex 之前是好的现在被修坏了（我从未要求改 block）, inline latex 一点都没动
complaint_resolution_evidence: The fix adds `(\$\$([\s\S]+?)\$\$)` as a HIGHER-precedence regex alternative (capture groups 10-11) BEFORE the inline `$...$` alternative (groups 12-13). When user types `Block: $$E=mc^2$$` mid-line, the lazy quantifier ensures the new alternative matches first at position N where source has `$$`. Bundle confirmed deployed and live regex test confirms Test C input matches as latex-display (NOT eaten by inline rule). User's `block was good, now broken` complaint was caused by cycle 1 inline regex eating inner $E=mc^2$ of mid-line $$E=mc^2$$; this fix resolves that. User's `inline latex 一点都没动` is verified by 2 inline .katex elements with correct annotation `a^2+b^2=c^2` rendering live on both viewports.
